description.en: Reserves an event of a given type/ID to run next (e.g. after the current map/dialogue finishes), optionally overwriting any already-reserved event.
Category of event to reserve, e.g. "STD".
ID of the event to reserve.
Whether to overwrite an already-reserved event.

Likely true once the event was reserved; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments). The success value is produced by an internal reservation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Reserve a standard event to run next
CMND_RESERVE_EVENT("STD", eventID, overwrite);
